text: We are a small shoe company that sells well-known sneaker brands and our own model, The Schu. Build our product catalog page. We want to increase sales and promote The Schu.
Build a checkout page for our online shoe shop that includes a newsletter sign-up. We want more people to sign up to our newsletter.
Create a product page for The Schu, our own sneaker. We need to get more people to buy our product.
Make a shopping cart page for a sneaker store, with a summary of the order and a way to continue to payment. We want fewer people to abandon their carts.
Design a pricing page for a note-taking app with a free plan, a Pro plan and a Team plan. We want more people to choose the Pro plan.
Build a subscription management page where a customer can see their current coffee subscription, change the delivery frequency, pause it or cancel it.
Create an order history page for an online bookstore, showing past orders with their status and a way to reorder or return items.
Build a landing page for a weekend flash sale on headphones at an electronics store.
Create a hotel room booking page where a guest picks dates, a room type and extras, then confirms the booking.
Make an account sign-up page for a meal-kit delivery service that also asks about dietary preferences.
Build an account settings page with profile details, email, password and a way to delete the account.
Create notification settings for a project management app, covering email, push and in-app notifications for different event types.
Make a privacy settings page for a social app: profile visibility, who can message me, data sharing with partners, and downloading my data.
Build a team members page for a SaaS admin console, listing members with roles and letting an admin invite, change roles and remove people.
Create a billing settings page showing the current plan, the payment method, invoices and a way to change or cancel the plan.
Make an API keys page for a developer platform where users can create, view, copy and revoke keys.
Build appearance settings for a code editor: theme, font size, line height, and a reset to defaults.
Create a security settings page with two-factor authentication, active sessions and recent login activity.
Build an integrations settings page for a CRM listing connected apps like Slack, Gmail and Zapier, with connect and disconnect actions.
Make workspace settings for a chat app: workspace name, logo, default channels, data retention, and archiving the workspace.
Build a sales dashboard for an online store showing revenue, orders, conversion rate and top products.
Create an operations dashboard for a support team: open tickets, average response time, tickets by priority and the agents' queue.
Make a personal finance dashboard with account balances, monthly spending by category and recent transactions.
Build a server monitoring dashboard showing CPU, memory, error rate, uptime and a list of recent incidents.
Create a marketing campaign dashboard with impressions, clicks, spend, cost per acquisition and a table of campaigns.
Make a fitness tracking dashboard showing steps, workouts this week, sleep and progress toward goals.
Build a project overview dashboard with milestones, task completion, team workload and upcoming deadlines.
Create an inventory dashboard for a warehouse: stock levels, items running low, incoming shipments and a full product list with 40 products.
Make a hiring pipeline dashboard showing candidates by stage, time to hire and a list of open roles.
Build a classroom dashboard for a teacher with attendance, assignment completion and a roster of all 32 students with their grades.
